explication: Azure PowerShell is a collection of PowerShell cmdlets for connecting to Azure and managing its resources. The documented user workflow is to sign in, inspect or change the session context and subscription, then discover and invoke module cmdlets; help and telemetry controls are additional capabilities. The tree shows many service-specific modules, so representative domains are grouped below rather than enumerating them all. No source excerpts were provided, so relationships are limited to those described in the README; paths identify existing module directories, not inspected implementations.
